$comment: Beginner callouts, shown one at a time in this order, each beside the element whose id is its anchor. A callout whose anchor isn't on the page is skipped. needsKeyLabels: true skips it while a demo hides key labels (before the user's guess). Matthew owns this wording; Stream K renders it. Drafts by Claude, Oct 7, 2026.

callouts.title: Start here
callouts.text: Turn your sound on and pick a tune. Every sound also shows on screen, so you can follow along with it off.

callouts.title: Where is home?
callouts.text: Most tunes keep coming back to one note and resting there. That note is home, and a key is just a name for where home is. Your answer is a guess, and you can change it any time.

callouts.title: These number keys are notes. 1 is home.
callouts.text: Press 1 to 7 on your computer's top row to climb the scale, the ladder of notes a tune is built from. The row below plays the same steps an octave lower: the same notes, sung in a deeper voice.

callouts.title: The tune, written out
callouts.text: Read it left to right; higher on the lines means a higher note. As it plays, each note lights up, so you can follow by eye.

callouts.title: Hover a chord to hear it under the tune.
callouts.text: A chord is a few notes played together by the left hand, underneath the melody (the part you'd hum). Try a few and keep the one that sounds right to you.

callouts.title: Blue circle means home; red square means tension.
callouts.text: Each chord's shape and color say what it does. Blue circle: home, at rest. Yellow triangle: stepping away. Red square: tension that wants to come home. Hear how red pulls back to blue?

callouts.title: Your controls
callouts.text: Play and stop the tune, and choose how chords are named. Transpose moves the whole tune higher or lower: the sound changes, but the numbers stay the same, because they count from home.

callouts.title: Stuck? Ask the tutor.
callouts.text: It's an AI music teacher. It points you to where to listen rather than handing you the answer, and you can ask for options or its best guess whenever you want more.
